name: LastTransaction-sourced line bypasses catalog repricing (carry-forward)
what_it_tests: A line whose ItemPricingSource='LastTransaction' must SKIP catalog price book, attribute pricing, partner/volume discount, and Quantity*Price recompute, preserving the prior-transaction price; on order reprice the prior order price is also preserved
proc_mechanism: Negative filters (ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction') on Attribute Pricing Filter, Quantity*Price, Manual Quote Level Discount, Partner Discount Derived Maint, List Operation; ListOperation80 (Equals 'LastTransaction') handles carry-forward
expected_behavior: Prior-transaction/order NetUnitPrice preserved; no catalog re-derivation
test_setup: Renewal/amend or order-reprice line with ItemPricingSource='LastTransaction', Qty=2

prior_run.actual: Force-reprice HARD-FAILS at StampBaseFilter#1 with SF-Pricing-00006/SF-BRE-00004 on BOTH A-02 quotes; CalculationStatus=PriceCalculationFailed; NetUnitPrice/NetTotalPrice/TotalLineAmount stay null. Carry-forward never computed. Control A-01 catalog quote reprices isSuccess=True (engine healthy), so failure is specific to the LastTransaction line.
prior_run.evidence: Quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FXA10AO/view (QLI 0QLWC000003kh8H4AQ); repro Quote 0Q0WC000003FX3Z0AW (QLI 0QLWC000003kh6f4AA); Asset 02iWC000008dekCYAQ priorNet 6695.30 / PBE 01uWC000005wrqzYAA list 0.00; control 0Q0WC000003FcHl0AK isSuccess=True
prior_run.defectStep: Stamp Base Filter (parent StampContributorBasePreDiscount, seq 14) criterion 5 'NetUnitPrice GreaterThan 0' not null-safe; cond logic (1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5 evaluates the null NetUnitPrice resource before the ItemPricingSource NotEquals LastTransaction exclusion can drop the line.
prior_run.notes: Same SF-BRE-00004 StampBaseFilter null-safety crash documented in SC-3441 (cancellation line, also null NetUnitPrice at reprice). Carry-forward branches exist and are correctly gated (ListOperation80 ItemPricingSource Equals LastTransaction -> NetUnitPrice*LineItemQuantity; AmendNetCarry Amend Filter), but they run at seq 26/39 AFTER StampBaseFilter (seq 14) which aborts the whole procedure first on the un-seeded null NetUnitPrice.
